`DieHard`, `DepthFirstErrorTrace`, and `DepthFirstTerminate` (`.tla` and
`.cfg`) are unchanged copies from `test-model` in TLA+ Tools commit
`5a47802b5c391f59ecdd44117981f4ff8c0656ba` (Java TLC 1.7.4). They are the
models of the JUnit tests `DepthFirstDieHardTest` (`-dfid 7`),
`DepthFirstErrorTraceTest` (`-dfid 9`), and `DepthFirstTerminate`
(`-dfid 50`), and `TestJavaTLCDepthFirst` checks them. See
[UPSTREAM-LICENSE](../../../../../UPSTREAM-LICENSE).
